name: Alegrete (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown, a quartered shield with a lion, a bull's head and plants, over a scroll reading CIDADE DE ALEGRETE 1814 1857.
history: Alegrete is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Flags of the World notes that a photograph on the municipal website shows a white flag with the arms at the centre.
